config.decoder: u = ubar + G h(z); NO bc(x) mask (the bank carries div-free-ness and the no-slip BC); h is a silu MLP with a linear skip
config.training: autodecoder: joint Adam over head parameters and one free latent code per training sample; no encoder
config.oracle: min_z ||c - h(z)|| by multi-start damped LM, vmapped over (case x restart) and scanned over iterations

S0.rule: solver output dtype float64; JAX x64=True, matmul_precision='highest', backend 'gpu' unless ALLOW_CPU=1

PRECOND.rule: ASSERTED unless SMOKE=1: the entire configuration equals the frozen contract; python runs WITHOUT -O (a raise, not an assert); a SMOKE=1 run never sets complete=true

S_SELECT.rule: BOTH training forms -- the autodecoder with free per-sample latent codes, and the supervised form with the latent pinned to the family parameter -- are run at the primary rung, and the primary is chosen on a VALIDATION cohort of 256 samples drawn from the same generator and disjoint from both the fit cohort and the frozen held-out cohort.  The held-out cohort chooses nothing.  Recorded because a training form selected after seeing the held-out number would make the stop gate meaningless

S_METRIC.rule: ||u - ubar - G h||_M must equal sqrt(||c - h||^2 + ||perp||_M^2) to 1e-12 relative, at 8 random h per mesh, measured against a DIRECT field computation.  Every reconstruction number in this driver is computed through that identity, so it is measured rather than assumed.  It holds because G is M_u-ORTHONORMAL (phase 2a, 1.3e-15)

S_REGR.rule: the phase-2b bank must reproduce the CERTIFIED phase-2a held-out POD-8 and POD-16 errors to 1e-09 relative, on the RAW psi-route bank (which is what phase 2a tabulated).  POD-32 is recorded, NOT gated at that tolerance: it is a 1e-12-scale cancellation whose value differs between the raw and reorthogonalised routes (2.6e-12 vs 3.1e-14 at N=64), so a relative comparison there measures roundoff, not agreement

S_AFFINE.rule: c(mu) = Cd theta(mu) - cbar, the map used to build the head's training cohort, must agree with coefficients taken from DIRECT FOM solves at phase 2a's own affine budget 1e-14 * N^2 (retraction 20: a FLAT tolerance here passed three meshes and failed the fourth on refinement alone)

S_RECON.rule: THE PREDECLARED STOP GATE, fixed before any training run: the held-out nonlinear RECONSTRUCTION ORACLE at N=64, R=32, K=8 must beat POD-8 by at least 3.0x in the AGGREGATE held-out error AND in the PER-CASE MEDIAN, on the identical held-out cohort in the identical mass-weighted norm.  This is a VERDICT, not an assertion: the artifact is written either way and stk2d_rom_gates.py refuses to run unless verdict.passed is true.  NEGATIVE CONTROLS, both ASSERTED: (1) a LINEAR head spans a K-dimensional affine subspace and therefore CANNOT beat POD-K -- its oracle error must sit within 1.5x of the POD-K floor and never below it; (2) an UNTRAINED head must be no better than POD-K.  Without those the gate could not distinguish 'the head works' from 'the metric is wrong'.  NOTE, stated because it is easy to misread: the head's error is bounded below by the POD-R TRUNCATION FLOOR at its own R, exactly, so at R = K the head can never beat POD-K and the R ladder is not a like-for-like comparison

MANIFEST.rule: ASSERTED unless SMOKE=1: every expected gate present, EXACT row counts, and no non-finite float anywhere in gates/
